name: spawn_daemon
description: Spawn a daemon process that automatically restarts when it terminates (up to max_restarts times). For long-running background services like file watchers or knowledge indexers. Each restart runs under a new PID, so re-read ps_processes to find it. Killing one incarnation triggers a restart until max_restarts is exhausted; set max_restarts to 0 when a single kill should be final.

name.description: Short name for the daemon process.

goal.description: The goal or task for the daemon to accomplish on each run.

priority.description: Process scheduling priority 0-255 (0=highest, 255=lowest). Default 10. Lower = more urgent; opposite direction of knowledge_save priority.

quota_turns.description: Maximum tool-calling turns per scheduler run before the daemon yields. Default 10.

max_restarts.description: Max automatic restarts after termination. Default 3.
